name: dsh-go
note: The APK is not committed: it is a ~190 MB binary and exceeds GitHub's per-file limit. Download it from the upstream releases page, or drop it next to serve-apk.mjs and pass --apk.

plugins.note: DSH Go installs ordinary DSH bundles. A mobile plugin is published to npm and listed in the DSH Go market; it does not need a separate package layout.

scripts.serve-apk.mjs: serve the APK over LAN for phone download
scripts.watch-and-install.ps1: wait for a device, then install
scripts.pair-host.mjs: render the pairing QR for this machine
